name: Oshioki☆Princess ~Tenshi to Akuma no Ecchi na Tatakai~
original_name: おしおき☆プリンセス ～天使と悪魔のえっちな戦い～
source:
The demon world finds itself in a difficult situation because of the war against heaven.
Rune Saber has managed to seal the demon overlord away.
Karen, the princess of the demon world, consults the overlord's close adviser Lucifer, and together they decide to head for the human realm.
Little does she know that it is all a scheme of Lucifer's devising...

Karen enrolls in the school where Rune Saber, AKA Nozomi Yuzuki goes.
As Karen interacts with Nozomi and her classmates, her feelings begin to change...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044205.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
魔界因与天庭之战而陷入困境。
符文刀成功封印了魔王。
魔界公主凯伦向魔王的近臣路西法请教，两人决定一起前往人界。
殊不知这一切都是路西法的阴谋……

凯伦就读于符文军刀（又名柚木希）就读的学校。
随着凯伦与希美和她的同学互动，她的感情开始发生变化……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044205.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
